audit.why: Chart matches the packet exactly (Garen 1-4, Skill at 6, Garen first item, Sejuani 2+ items) and the 52.33% win rate over 1628 games. The mirror audit kept the same Garen-favoured early shape, so both directions agree.

All four spikes present and correctly placed: Garen's 3-5 melee window, the even Level 6 ult trade (R 120/100/80 versus Glacial Prison 120/105/90), first-item tempo, and Sejuani's late tank scaling. Mirror framed the same window as widest at low ranks and narrowing as she levels W (9s down to 5s), which this side now reflects.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[5] listed Permafrost at an 11-second cooldown. Riot's data has Permafrost on a 1.5-second cooldown at 560 range; it is not a spell you wait out. It also only fires against a target already at maximum Frost stacks, which Winter's Wrath (9/8/7/6/5) applies. report[9] and report[10] both told the player to commit and to call the jungler 'when Permafrost is down' — advice built on the wrong number. Nothing anywhere stated that Decisive Strike breaks free of all slows, or that Courage grants tenacity.
audit.why: The real gate is Winter's Wrath, not Permafrost: no Frost stacks, no stun. Garen's Q text is explicit — 'breaking free of all slows affecting him' — so Winter's Wrath's slow and the Glacial Prison ice storm slow do not kite him, and slow-based zoning does not function in this matchup. Courage grants a shield AND tenacity, which shortens the Permafrost and Glacial Prison stuns. Conversely Sejuani's Frost Armor grants immunity to slows, so Garen's own Q slow does nothing while it holds. The real engage cooldown to bait is Arctic Assault at 18s rank 1.
audit.corrected: Name Winter's Wrath as the stun's fuel, key commitment to Arctic Assault's 18s cooldown, and state the Q slow-cleanse and Courage tenacity both ways.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flagged 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'. Every all-in line pointed at a 1.5-second cooldown.
audit.why: Arctic Assault at 18/16.5/15/13.5/12 is the only long punishable cooldown in her kit and is her sole gap-closer.
audit.corrected: All-in and jungle windows re-keyed to Arctic Assault's 18s rank-1 cooldown.

edits.before: Track Sejuani’s Permafrost (11s): Her stun after Frost stacks. Don't get stacked + stunned. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Permafrost stuns only at max Frost stacks, and Winter's Wrath (9s to 5s) is what applies them — deny the W, deny the stun.

edits.before: Commit on Permafrost’s cooldown, at your level/item spikes, and with jungle setup — bait his answer before you spend yours.
edits.after: Commit when Arctic Assault (18s at rank 1) is down — that is her only engage. Permafrost's 1.5s cooldown never runs out.

edits.before: Ward the river bush on his push timings and ping your jungler when Permafrost is down — that is the gank window. Never fight 1v2 to protect a dead wave.
edits.after: Ward the river bush on her push timings and ping your jungler once Arctic Assault is down — that is the gank window. Never fight 1v2 for a dead wave.

edits.before: Trade into his Permafrost. Spin into a freeze you can't reach. All-in without Q move speed up. Treat your ultimate as a verdict, never as harassment.
edits.after: Letting Frost stacks sit on you at max. Spin into a freeze you can't reach. All-in without Q move speed up. Treat your ultimate as a verdict, not harassment.

edits.before: : Sejuani changes the lane by forcing Garen to respect Sejuani frost armor stacking and glacial prison R.
edits.after: Her stun needs max Frost stacks from Winter's Wrath — silence the W and Permafrost has nothing left to fire.

edits.before: Sejuani frost armor stacking and glacial prison R
edits.after: Frost stacks from W arming Permafrost's stun

edits.before: Levels 3-5 you spin E while her Frost Armor only stalls.
edits.after: At 3-5 Courage's tenacity blunts her stun as you spin E.

edits.before: You out-damage Sejuani's weak early kit: close with Q, silence her Arctic Assault dash, and spin E - her Frost Armor only stalls the trade she is losing.
edits.after: You out-damage her weak early kit: Q breaks free of all slows, so Winter's Wrath cannot kite you — close, silence Arctic Assault, and spin E freely.

edits.before: You win melee trades: Sejuani is a tank with weak early damage, so close with Q, silence her off Arctic Assault, and spin E while she cannot Winter's Wrath you away. Her Frost Armor passive stall only delays the loss.
edits.after: You win melee trades: Sejuani is a tank with weak early damage. Q breaks free of Winter's Wrath's slow so she cannot kite you, and the silence denies Arctic Assault — spin E while Frost Armor only stalls the loss.

edits.before: Sejuani scales into a tanky teamfight engage that Frost-stacks and Glacial-Prisons your carries; her R and stat-check tankiness overtake your dueling into the late game.
edits.after: Sejuani scales into a tanky teamfight engage: Frost Armor grants immunity to slows so your Q slow does nothing, and Glacial Prison locks your carries from 1300 range.

notes: Permafrost's cooldown was stated as 11s across the page; Riot's value is 1.5s. Three separate 'wait for Permafrost' lines were therefore giving unusable advice and have been re-keyed to Arctic Assault (18s at rank 1). Mirror sejuani__garen already carried the Q slow-cleanse and Courage-tenacity findings; both are now stated from Garen's side without contradicting it. Level chart matched the packet and was left untouched.
